def shortest_path(graph: Map[String, List[String]], start: String, goal: String) -> Result[Int]
  queue = [start]
  head = 0
  distance: Map[String, Int] = {start: 0}
  while head < queue.size
    node = queue[head]
    head += 1
    steps = distance[node]
    if node == goal
      return ok(steps)
    end
    for next in graph.get(node, [])
      if not distance.has_key?(next)
        distance = distance.put(next, steps + 1)
        queue = queue.push(next)
      end
    end
  end
  return error("no path from #{start} to #{goal}")
end

struct Memo
  value: Int
  cache: Map[Int, Int]
end

def fib(n: Int, cache: Map[Int, Int]) -> Memo
  if n < 2
    return Memo(value: n, cache: cache)
  end
  if cache.has_key?(n)
    return Memo(value: cache[n], cache: cache)
  end
  left = fib(n - 1, cache)
  right = fib(n - 2, left.cache)
  total = left.value + right.value
  return Memo(value: total, cache: right.cache.put(n, total))
end

def factorial(n: Int) -> Int
  if n <= 1
    return 1
  end
  return n * factorial(n - 1)
end

def flatten(groups: List[List[Int]]) -> List[Int]
  result: List[Int] = []
  for group in groups
    result = result.concat(group)
  end
  return result
end

def hanoi(n: Int, from: String, to: String, via: String) -> Int
  if n == 0
    return 0
  end
  return hanoi(n - 1, from, via, to) + 1 + hanoi(n - 1, via, to, from)
end

enum Event
  Item(String, Int)
  Failed(String)
end

struct Source
  name: String
  count: Int
  events: Channel[Event]
end

struct Coordinator
  sources: List[Task[Void]]
  events: Channel[Event]
end

def emit(source: Source) -> Void
  i = 1
  while i <= source.count
    source.events.send(Event.Item(source.name, i * 10), 1000)
    i += 1
  end
  if source.count == 0
    source.events.send(Event.Failed("#{source.name} has nothing"), 1000)
  end
end

def coordinate(c: Coordinator) -> Void
  c.sources.each do |source|
    Task.await(source)
  end
  c.events.close
end

def main() -> Void
  events: Channel[Event] = Channel.new(2)
  sources = [
    Task.spawn(&emit, Source(name: "a", count: 3, events: events)),
    Task.spawn(&emit, Source(name: "b", count: 0, events: events)),
    Task.spawn(&emit, Source(name: "c", count: 2, events: events))
  ]
  coordinator = Task.spawn(&coordinate, Coordinator(sources: sources, events: events))
  totals: Map[String, Int] = {}
  while true
    case events.recv(1000)
      ok(event) ->
        case event
          Event.Item(name, value) -> totals = totals.put(name, totals.get(name, 0) + value)
          Event.Failed(text) -> puts(text)
        end
      error(_) ->
        if events.closed?
          break
        end
    end
  end
  Task.await(coordinator)
  puts(totals)
end
